units.text: INT. WAX MUSEUM - AFTER HOURS
Rows of figures in fading finery.
A single lantern.
Dust on the Duke of Wellington's boots.
INSPECTOR CALLOWAY (50s, rumpled overcoat, notebook) stands beside a plinth.
MADAME ZELENKA (60s, turban, jeweled fingers) sits stiffly on a chaise.
PERCIVAL (30s, curator's smock) wrings a handkerchief.
LADY MARGUERITE (40s, widow's veil) holds a fan.
TOMMASO (20s, night guard's cap) fidgets by the door.
Let us review. The Duke was found at midnight with his head missing.
units.name: CALLOWAY

units.text: It is the wax, Inspector. Wax is delicate.
units.name: PERCIVAL

units.text: It is also not usually missing.
units.name: CALLOWAY

units.text: I was admiring the Duke at eleven. He was whole.
units.name: MARGUERITE

units.text: I felt a presence. A cold one. It lingered.
units.name: ZELENKA

units.text: I locked the doors at ten. No one came in.
units.name: TOMMASO

units.text: Then no one went out. Which means the head is here.
units.name: CALLOWAY

units.text: You can't think one of us...
units.name: PERCIVAL

units.text: I think a head cannot walk. Madame Zelenka, your turban looks heavy.
units.name: CALLOWAY

units.text: It is Persian silk, Inspector.
units.name: ZELENKA

units.text: It is lumpy.
units.name: CALLOWAY

units.text: She hesitates.
Unwinds the cloth.
Inside, nothing but hair.
She smiles thinly.
Inspector, my fan.
units.name: MARGUERITE

units.text: Lady Marguerite, your veil has stopped moving.
units.name: CALLOWAY

units.text: She stiffens.
Tommaso drops his cap.
Percival laughs, high and tinny.
It's under the chaise, I'm afraid. I only meant to repair the nose.
units.name: PERCIVAL
